entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: When I text you from that ID, it'll be[n]'cause I need help around the shop.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Just so you know, if you get caught or[n]anything, I never met ya. Nothin' to do[n]with me. We clear?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: If you want somethin', you're gonna[n]have to work for it.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Hmph. We'll see if you're actually up to it.[n]Point is, we got a deal now, so you'd[n]better put in some work.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: No guarantees. But hey, we already[n]made the deal, so no backin' out now.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Yeesh. Take it easy there, cowboy.[n]You're that eager to get into it, huh?

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: I'll send a message when everything's[n]ready. Hope I can count on you, kid.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Okay, that's it for today. Head on home,[n]part-timer.
